units.translation: properly, for the chaste to see when they seek
most worthy of account of those who came before

In 31 ⟦1⟧ (this is the traditional spelling) the absence of the verb is offensive (sc. ⟦2⟧ Dindorf), but also the ⟦3⟧', which would have to mean "sent from," whereas the thought requires the simple partitive. Thus GHermann and Abresch write ⟦4⟧', which can stand for ⟦5⟧, see ⟦6⟧. ⟦7⟧. ⟦8⟧, though it is not readily elided (any more than ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧). The change ⟦11⟧. ⟦12⟧ (Burges, Weckl.) makes things worse, not only because the plural follows, but also because the singular is unmotivated. According to Plut. Qu. gr. 9, oracles were given only once a month, so each time a larger number of consultants had to gather. Thus ⟦13⟧' has the least objection. On ⟦14⟧ there is no further emphasis, as if barbarians in general were also thought of (cf. ⟦15⟧, see below); they were not usually present. Among the consultants there was a drawing of lots for the order (unless a state had the ⟦16⟧); hence ⟦17⟧ by Apollo ⟦18⟧ (Paley). According to Simplicius in ⟦19⟧, the drawing of lots was preceded by the question: ⟦20⟧, ⟦21⟧ (Weckl. for ⟦22⟧) ⟦23⟧; This is, as Schütz rightly saw, the guidance of the god, of which V. 33 speaks; therefore one should not write ⟦24⟧ (Kirchhoff), however easy the change is. For it is motivated by custom and practice, and that is better than an explanation of what the P. now intends to do.
to assign the oracle by lot
to whom do you give oracles?
⟦1⟧ (only here) is formed from ⟦2⟧ as ⟦3⟧ from ⟦4⟧, without the internal ⟦5⟧, alongside ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧.

The Pythia comes out again in terror and announces the cause. Although no one in what follows is addressed or even indicated as a listener, the oracle consultants of V. 31 can easily be understood as listeners, since the matter concerns them too; for no oracles will be given for the time being. The scholiast in the summary of V. 1 rejects the opinion that this is a Euripidean prologue for the spectators (⟦1⟧ in the scholion is "that behind the stage," as ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ "behind the door"); in fact, the speech must be thought of as addressed, as at the beginning to the invoked gods, so now to specific people, as ⟦4⟧ immediately shows: I can scarcely tell you, just as I scarcely endured the sight. (On the anaphora to ⟦5⟧.)
